prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally crafted, fully legible mobile-web ordering app screen, flat portrait artboard 390 x 844 logical px, rendered high resolution. This is OPTION C: DIRECT MENU WITH CATEGORY FILTERS AND DESTINATION LABELS PER PRODUCT. It is a finished implementable screen, NOT a phone mockup, poster or moodboard. Reference1 is the original Tromsø Countryfestival bull+lockup, reuse faithfully with unchanged proportions; reference2 supplies the existing black/white/beige festival identity and Rye/Poppins type voice, but REPLACE its category-doorway structure with the following exact compact product-list composition. Black top header, original logo on left, Country Saloon smaller below, Hjelp action right; keep header around 90px. Next white location row "Bord P07" with "Endre" on right; underneath small guide "Pakker til bordet. Øvrige varer hentes." in easily readable 14px UI type. Then Rye heading "Meny" at 30px, modest scale. Category filters in compact two-row layout with 44px touch height: "Alle" selected black with white lettering; "Bordpakker", "Drikke", "Alkoholfritt", "Mat & snacks" unselected on white with thin rules, no outlined pill overload. Then five product rows on WHITE separated by fine horizontal rules, no container cards and no product art. Each row has 17px semibold product name left, 14px destination label below with a small clear monochrome arrow icon if helpful, 16px price below/alongside, a 44px beige ADD button at the right. Rows exactly: 1) "6 øl, cider eller seltzer", destination "Til bord P07", price "690 kr", button "Velg". 2) "Mack Pilsner · 0,5 l", destination "Hentes i baren", price "115 kr", plus button. 3) "Alkoholfri øl · 0,33 l", destination "Hentes i baren", price "65 kr", plus button. 4) "Pølse", destination "Hentes i matboden", price "85 kr", plus button. 5) "Potetgull", destination "Hentes i baren", price "45 kr", plus button. Show the five real rows and their complete labels, none hidden under fixed navigation. Use around 75px per row. Small bottom note "Prototype · eksempelpriser". Fixed bottom navigation "Meny" active and "Mine bestillinger" inactive. This is the initial menu, basket empty so no checkout/cart bar. Palette ONLY black #000, white #fff, ink #111, beige #e1d8c9, secondary #555 and light gray rules. Text is true black on white, not a beige page. Body and controls Poppins, restrained Rye display heading only. Strong precise alignment and reading hierarchy, no oversized hero, no gradients, no shadows, no photos, no decorative country clipart, no new logo, no fake sales claims, no invented wait times. All screen copy Norwegian Bokmål exactly quoted. This option must visibly show instant access to products and total clarity about the destination of EVERY item; category filters and individual route labels distinguish it from destination-section layout.
